# What to charge per charter trip: break-even, target price and what weather cancellations really cost

> Free pricing calculator for fishing charter captains: fuel, deckhand, fixed costs, weather cancellations and the profit you want become a break-even price, a target price per trip and per angler. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
